scientific_integrity: Exact exhaustive flag-orbit construction for the full and even permutation groups; cell collapses checked as genuine free-face moves; nonabelian attaching words and all eleven homotopy-preserving generator/two-cell cancellations replayed by standalone standard-library verifier. The result has same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Single graph and only two symmetry groups; no classification of other subgroups, other graphs, or equivariant integral homology representations. Prior rational quotient-homology results are credited. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a publication-priority risk; no independent scientific audit.
title: Integral homotopy types of the alternating and symmetric Petersen matching quotients
